tool_calling_support: Alias hardcodes --tools read,edit,write,bash,grep,glob, so tool support depends entirely on the model behind nexgate/coopforge/bielik-minitron-7b emitting valid OpenAI-compat tool_calls through LiteLLM. Raw curl gate with 1 tool (get_time) and short prompt: 20/20 valid, 0 malformed (100%, pass bar >=90). Full omp sessions: edits 0/4 in both suite variants — agentic tool-calling unproven [uncertain: coopforge_tool_calling_native]. Model version not pinned [uncertain: coopforge_model_version].
context_and_limits: Alias passes --system-prompt ~/.omp/bielik/SYSTEM.md (3.2 KB ~770 tokens) + 6 tool schemas; total prompt+tools budget <=3k tokens per spec — satisfied. Route limits: context_window 32768, maxTokens 8192 (litellm route), models.yml mirrors contextWindow 32768 / maxTokens 8192. Suite TASK_TIMEOUT default 300 s.
model_registration: Model is registered in ~/.omp/agent/models.yml as id/name coopforge/bielik-minitron-7b, api openai-completions, baseUrl http://127.0.0.1:4000/v1 (NexGate LiteLLM), contextWindow 32768, maxTokens 8192, reasoning false, input [text], supportsTools true. Alias references it as --model nexgate/coopforge/bielik-minitron-7b (nexgate/ prefix form; models.yml row uses the bare id — both resolve today, prefix vs bare resolution not separately documented) [uncertain]. No apiKeyEnv in the row: auth flows via LITELLM_MASTER_KEY in the pre-flight curl; omp itself talks to the gateway which enforces the key. A separate bare 'bielik' models.yml row exists (contextWindow 16384) for the older local route — not used by this alias.
flags_and_budget: Alias flags: --model nexgate/coopforge/bielik-minitron-7b, --system-prompt ~/.omp/bielik/SYSTEM.md, --tools read,edit,write,bash,grep,glob, --no-skills --no-rules --no-extensions --no-lsp --no-title, plus rc-gate discovery: walks $PWD up to / adding -e <dir>/.omp/extensions/reasoning_core_gate.ts when found (explicit -e is required because --no-extensions disables discovery). Advisor is not built in — user appends --advisor per design. Budget: SYSTEM.md 3.2 KB + 6 narrow tool schemas keeps prompt+tools <=3k tokens.
litellm_route: Alias targets http://127.0.0.1:4000/v1 route coopforge/bielik-minitron-7b in runtime/config/litellm.yaml.tmpl (rendered litellm.yaml is regenerated by scripts/render-litellm-config.py — hand-edits wiped): model openai/bielik-minitron-7b, api_base NEXGATE_COOPFORGE_BIELIK_API_BASE, api_key NEXGATE_COOPFORGE_BIELIK_API_KEY, drop_params true + additional_drop_params [web_search_options], max_tokens 8192, region_name eu; model_info: context_window 32768, supports_function_calling/tool_choice/parallel_function_calling true; context_window_fallbacks for coopforge/bielik-minitron-7b: [] (no fallback, fail loud); also absent from the SIMPLE complexity tier. Bare 'bielik' route falls back to [scaleway-devstral, mistral]. Pre-flight gate: curl -s -m 5 /v1/models with LITELLM_MASTER_KEY, requires HTTP 2xx, else prints Polish error and returns 1.
backend_serving: Alias is backend-agnostic (OpenAI-compat through LiteLLM). Coopforge endpoint is remote EU, DEV1-L-class CPU-only VM per coopforge-web tier data (default_model bielik-minitron-7b, ~5 GB model) [uncertain: engine — Ollama vs vLLM]. Coopforge-infra tier maps bielik-minitron-7b to openai/SpeakLeash/bielik-minitron-7B-v3.0-instruct:Q4_K_M at http://ollama:11434/v1; whether nexgate/coopforge serves that exact tag unconfirmed [uncertain]. If vLLM were used, hermes parser + --enable-auto-tool-choice would be the documented serving flags; none observed locally for this route [uncertain]. Local Mac Studio Ollama serving untested [uncertain: ollama_local_serving_on_mac_studio].
tool_call_rate: Gateway curl gate (1 tool, short prompt): 100% (20/20). Suite through the alias path (same flags): v1 broad-tools 33% (3/9, cancelled), v2 narrow-tools 16% (2/12); all 4 edit tasks fail both runs — narrowing tools did not recover edits. Instability between gate and suite indicates context-length/session drift, not alias wiring [uncertain: per-task no-tool-call vs timeout split unlogged].
streaming_behavior: No streaming-specific instrumentation for this alias/route; many suite tasks hit ~300 s TASK_TIMEOUT, consistent with 2.4k+ token generation stalls but unproven [uncertain: tool_calls survival through LiteLLM streaming; timeout behavior at 2.4k+ tokens].
reasoning_core_gate: Alias auto-discovers the rc gate: walks up from $PWD to / looking for .omp/extensions/reasoning_core_gate.ts and appends -e <path> (explicit load needed since --no-extensions). Loaded in repos where rc init --host omp placed the extension; otherwise plain session.
pass_criteria: Bar: suite >=80%, <=1 retry/task, <=2 tool-errors/task, failure classes timeout vs no-tool-call vs hallucination. Measured: 33%/16% — FAIL; model is the blocker, not the alias. Alias acceptance met: pre-flight curl present (returns 1 with message on gateway down), narrow toolset, advisor opt-in documented in header comment, Polish smoke test per plan.
